note: Provenance only. The tile URLs are references to the imagery's origin; the runtime simulator reads the LOCAL files listed under local_path. Large rasters are not committed (see .gitignore) and must be placed locally.

sources.resolution_note: Web Mercator nominal metres; true ground metres differ by cos(latitude). V2 treats the raster's nominal metre as the local world metre.
sources.nodata: no nodata value; per-dataset mask present, corners are zero-fill
